name: Point Cloud
summary: Thousands of event particles morph from a swarm of dashboards into the pulse line and a dot-stacked chart, where three coral embers refuse to settle.
look: Soft teal particles on a deep blue-black void, additive and slightly glowing. Every morph lands on a readable shape (dashboard outlines, the pulse waveform, a per-minute dot chart, a calm ring), and the anomaly is a handful of coral embers with trails.

components.name: Particle field
components.role: 10–20k soft points (WebGL or canvas 2D, additive); one point = one event

components.name: Target shapes
components.role: position buffers sampled from SVG/text: dashboards, pulse line, dot chart, ring

components.name: Coral embers
components.role: outlier points with glow and trail that refuse to settle; the anomaly

components.name: Expected-level ghosts
components.role: dashed coral rings where points should be; the drop shown as absence

components.name: Pinned labels
components.role: mono HUD text and a dashed leader from ember to decision card

components.name: Event counter
components.role: '2,418 events/sec' readout that sells the scale being watched

motion.name: Shape morph
motion.how: uProgress 0→1 between position buffers, per-particle delay by index, power3.inOut 1.6 s from the 0:08 drop

motion.name: Curl drift
motion.how: seeded noise keeps the idle cloud breathing; amplitude pumps +20 % on each kick at 120 BPM

motion.name: Ember isolation
motion.how: flagged points detach upward and the camera pushes in, expo.out 0.8 s, landing on the snare

story: Hook: dashboard outlines shed particles into a vortex under '2,418 events/sec' and 'How many dashboards did you check today?'. Reveal: on the drop the swarm snaps into one pulse waveform with a coral head, and the Acme Pulse lockup fades up. Proof: particles stack into a per-minute checkout chart; after 09:42 the stacks fall short, three coral embers lift off and a card reads 'Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231' with Roll back. CTA: the cloud relaxes into an orbiting ring around 'Every metric. Every minute.' and Start free.
adapt: Map one particle to one unit of your product (a request, an order, a session) and morph the cloud into your own chart; the embers become whatever your product flags.

fit.risk: Particle 'AI dust' is a cliché; every morph must land on a real, readable data shape.
